core.title: Polished Brass 88 Series Rim Exit Device with Lever Trim, Von Duprin 88L3

text.description_html:
88 Series Polished Brass Rim Cross Exit Device, Von Duprin 88L3

88 Rim Devices are for all all types of single and double doors with mullion. Covers stock hollow metal doors with 86 or 161 cutouts.

Von Duprin Series 88 Exit devices are UL listed from Accident Hazard and Fire Exit Hardware, and are tested in accordance to ANSI A156.3, 1994, Grade1.

Device is furnished standard with Polished Brass 373L Lever trim and 299 strike in dull black finish. All necessary mounting hardware is included.

Features and Specifications: for Von Duprin 88 Series Rim Cross Exit Device

  • Includes Matching 373L Lever Trim
  • Field Reversible Handing
  • Field Sizeable
  • 3/4" (19mm) Throw Latch Bolt
  • Available in 5 finishes
  • Hex Key Dogging
  • Crossbar Projection Neutral: 4-3/4"
  • Crossbar Length: 42"
  • Lock Stile Case: 8-1/4"x2-3/4"x15/16"
  • Hinge Stile Case: 6"x1-3/4"x15/16"
  • Crossbar Diameter: 1"
  • Grade 1
